resources.string: All processing happens on this device. Typed text is never logged or uploaded.
Correct typos and capitalize sentences using the built-in dictionary and your learned words.
OFF by default. Encrypt the whole field and append the armored block when you press Enter.

Auto-append mode is experimental. Your plaintext may already be saved in the other app\'s draft/autosave before encryption runs. The keyboard cannot detect a real \"send\" event, so the block may be appended to an unsent message. Some apps may reject or mangle the appended text.
Privacy: no keystroke logging, no analytics, no network access. Only two settings and learned word counts are stored in app-private storage.

This mode can leak plaintext through provider draft autosave, cannot detect when a message is actually sent, and may break some apps. Recommended: leave it OFF and use the shield key to encrypt explicitly.
